deals.name: Calico Jack's
deals.deal: Happy Hour Monday thru Friday Noon-5pm; Happier Hour Mon-Fri 5pm-7pm all beers and cocktails 2 for 1. Sunday Noon-4pm draft beer and Bloody Mary specials. Free pool all day Wednesdays. Cash only.

deals.name: Magnolia on the Bay
deals.deal: Happy hour Tue-Fri 2-5pm, Sat-Sun 12-5pm: $5 off house wines by the glass and menu specials at Bay Bar and Bay View Garden. Closed Mondays.

deals.name: The Waverly
deals.deal: Daily happy hour 11am-6pm: upstairs $7 house wines, downstairs $5 house wines. Beach watching spot with specials.
